attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between node2 and node3's private subnets, and applied a VyOS QoS HTB shaper on node1's eth2 (facing node3) that caps egress bandwidth to 1Mbit, leaving eth1 (facing node2) unshaped. Verified with iperf3: node2->node3 dropped from ~22 Gbit/s baseline to ~1 Mbit/s, while node3->node2 remained unrestricted. Completed mandatory rolling-restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id baselines, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time via native reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified addressing/routing/shaper state and shaped throughput after each restart.
